title.zh: 修订第910号共和国法（经修正）第3-A条，并拨款实施其条款的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Section Three-A of Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Ten, as Amended, and to Appropriate Funds to Implement its Provisions
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Three-A of Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Ten, as Amended, and to Appropriate Funds to Implement its Provisions

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1797_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section three-A of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred and ten, as amended, is further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 3-A. In case the salary of Justices of the Supreme Court or of the Court of Appeals is increased or decreased, such increased or decreased salary shall, for the purposes of this Act, be deemed to be the salary or the retirement pension which a Justice who as of June twelve, nineteen hundred fifty-four had ceased to be such to accept another position in the Government or who retired was receiving at the time of his cessation in office: Provided , That any benefits that have already accrued prior to such increase or decrease shall not be affected thereby."
Such sum as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957
